text:
ana_k: Drafted a longer-horizon roadmap doc for 'Strata' — trying to synthesize routing policies, multi-region commitments, and multi-tenant isolation lanes. Posting the rough acceptance criteria + open questions. pls skim and flag blind spots.

lucas: thanks — linking it in the docs channel helps, but quick ask: does this assume dedicated pools for enterprise customers or soft isolation via routing policies?

ana_k: (that's ana_k again) Good call — current draft mixes approaches. Primary path is policy-driven slices first, with a clear migration path to dedicated pools for customers above a cost/latency threshold.

meera: +1. We should be explicit about SLA tiers and what triggers an isolation upgrade. engineers keep asking for deterministic triggers.

ana_k: Agreed. Draft acceptance criteria I put in the doc: 
```
- Canary: < 50ms p50 for control lane, < 100ms p95 for isolation lane during 95th percentile load
- Cutover trigger: sustained cost > $X/month OR error-rate spike > 3x baseline OR customer request + contract clause
- Compliance: data residency for isolation lanes enabled for EU customers (KMS integration verified)
- Rollout: canary -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automatic rollback on latency/regression
```

tj: those numbers look sensible. Can we add a soft-fallback rule to route to smaller quantized model variant if isolation lanes are saturated?

samir: yes — fallback is critical. Also add a 'graceful degradation' requirement: customer-visible correctness regression must be within an eval delta of 2% on our prompt suite.

meera: For multi-region, we need a clear consistency model for session affinity. My recommendation: session affinity preferred within region, but allow cross-region failover when latency > threshold OR capacity pressure > N. Document should show thresholds.

ana_k: noted. Also thinking about routing precedence: 
- explicit customer pin -> dedicated pool -> isolation lane (policy) -> hosted best-effort
- fallbacks allow model downgrade -> region failover -> read-only degraded features.

eng-bot: deploy-check: model-quant-profiles v2 must be available in west-eu and us-west before staged rollout.

lucas: Action items: 1) Meera to propose region affinity thresholds (due EOD Thu). 2) Eng-ml to define eval delta metric and test harness for rollback (samir to own). 3) Product to finalize cutover economic threshold (ana_k).

samir: I'll stub an evaluation harness. Quick question — do we require customers to opt into isolation or opt-out? For enterprises we'd prefer opt-in, but can we auto-upgrade for safety?

ana_k: policy: default = hosted shared; opt-in for dedicated. Auto-upgrade only for safety scenarios (SLA breach risk) with opt-out in contract for enterprise legal. Will add wording.

meera: One more: telemetry. We need per-tenant trace IDs for routing decisions + a latency budget dashboard. Otherwise owners can't debug cutovers.

tj: +emoji:thumbsup: Also add a short checklist for on-call to follow during rollouts: how to throttle canary, when to trigger fallback rules, contact matrix.

ana_k: will add on-call checklist and add a small decision matrix in the doc. If no major objections, I'll treat this as the canonical Strata roadmap draft and open a product/architecture sync next week to lock priorities.

lucas: No objections from me. small nit: spell out costs assumptions in appendix.

samir: fine. I'll prepare the eval harness PR by Tue.

ana_k: thanks all — closing thread for now. Will ping when the doc is updated. :v:
